data.current_summary: Record hosted-policy consent (public, no API key)
data.current_description:
Records a consent event for a hosted policy. This is the same endpoint our hosted-policy 'I Agree' button calls; it is also useful for custom checkout pages that link out to your hosted policy and want to log the consent without minting an API key on the client.

**No authentication required.** The owner is discovered from the policy itself. CORS is fully open. The policy must have hosting enabled.

Records land in the unified `consent_records` table and are retrievable via `GET /api/v1/consent?policy_id=...`.
data.summary_suggestion: Record user consent for a hosted policy
data.description_suggestion: Records a consent event for a hosted policy without requiring API authentication. Designed for use by hosted policy 'I Agree' buttons and custom checkout pages. The policy owner is automatically determined from the policy ID. Requires the policy to have hosting enabled. CORS is fully enabled for cross-origin requests. The consent record is stored in the unified consent_records table and can be retrieved using GET /api/v1/consent?policy_id=... for compliance audits. Returns the created consent record with timestamp and policy version.
